summary: RAG anti-modal contrast on v2a_e1 LoRA re-judge
hypothesis: The +0.030 quality gain seen in exp078 (0.470 vs champion 0.440) is a real signal above judge-noise, not a lucky Sonnet draw — re-running the identical deterministic pipeline with a fresh Sonnet judge should replicate the score and confirm exp078 as the new best.
technique: Exact replication of exp078's deterministic on-device pipeline (RAG anti-modal contrast retrieval feeding a v2a_e1 LoRA generate call, greedy decoding) with a fresh independent Sonnet judge pass — no pipeline changes, only a new stochastic judge call — to isolate judge noise from true quality signal.
result: Scored 0.402 on the full-30 greedy eval, well below exp078's 0.470 and even below champion exp056's 0.440 — the re-judge did not replicate the prior score, indicating the exp078 result fell within judge-noise variance rather than representing a genuine quality improvement. Discarded; exp078 is not confirmed as the new best.
